question: In 2025, what share of orders contained more than one item line? Compare average ordered units per order for one-line and multi-line orders; also report orders with no item line separately.

action.query:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT IS NULL OR i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 0 THEN 'No item line'
    WHEN i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 1 THEN 'One item line'
    ELSE 'Multiple item lines'
  END AS order_item_line_group,
  COUNT(o.ORDER_ID) AS order_count,
  SUM(i.ITEM_QUANTITY) AS total_ordered_quantity,
  AVG(i.ITEM_QUANTITY) AS avg_ordered_quantity_per_order
FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER o
LEFT JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_ITEM_ROLLUP i
  ON o.ORDER_ID = i.ORDER_ID
WHERE o.ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND o.ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 
  CASE order_item_line_group 
    WHEN 'No item line' THEN 0 
    WHEN 'One item line' THEN 1 
    ELSE 2 END

action.answer:
In 2025, among all recorded orders:

- Orders with one item line: 1,307,684 orders (average ordered units per order: 1.219753)
- Orders with multiple item lines: 3,052,089 orders (average ordered units per order: 3.484769)
- Orders with no item line: 0 orders (none were found in the data)

Share of orders with more than one item line: 3,052,089 / (1,307,684 + 3,052,089) = 0.700323 (70.0323%)

Interpretation:
- 70.0323% of orders in 2025 contained more than one item line.
- Multi-line orders had a much higher average ordered quantity (3.484769 units per order) compared to single-line orders (1.219753 units per order).
- No orders were found without any item line in this period and dataset.
action.reason: All requested values are included: order counts, shares, and average ordered units per order for each group. No orders with zero item lines were found.
